shard: brief
gist: Three-voice round for an EVOLVABILITY CONTRACT: the ratified rules by which future atom schema revisions land without breaking any reader.

Candidate laws: additive-optional fields never bump the version (semantic changes only); unknown-key ROUND-TRIP preservation (a v1 writer flipping status on a v2 atom must not strip v2 fields); replay-totality — rebuild handles every historical shape FOREVER via pure per-version upgrade shims chained at read; history is NEVER rewritten

gold: THE HONEST DIFFERENCE, which reframes the entire problem: "packets are EPHEMERAL (TTL'd streams; version skew is transient) — atoms are FOREVER (append-only JSONL replayed at every rebuild; every shape ever minted must stay readable for the life of the project). And the fire-verification law applied to schema: run a fixture v-next atom against EVERY consumer and verify refuse-loud fires where unshimmed, before any v2 lands.

shard: design-3
gist: Friction audit of the ten agent directives D1-D10, mapping each onto the reliability spectrum and prescribing mechanical fixes, ranked.
settled: RELIABILITY IS A PROPERTY OF DESIGN, NOT DILIGENCE
The reliability spectrum: forcing-function → just-in-time prompt → documentation → tribal memory. The further right, the more it leaks. Move each directive as far left as its value and risk justify.
Motivation is NOT a usable lever for an agent — reliability ≈ Ability × Prompt
Bounded autonomy: when you let the model CHOOSE whether to follow a step, completion can fall as low as 4%; the fix is architectural — eliminate the choice
Keep the obligatory list short (5-9, checklist-sized)
Fail closed, and teach the fix in the error

shard: design-3
gist: The FAITH-1 rationale: why the faithfulness critic is deterministic and no-LLM, which signals are HARD-gated vs SOFT, and why it ships in shadow posture.
settled: Don't judge with an LLM: position bias (~30% first-slot) + self-preference; general faithfulness metrics perform near chance (~0.70 AUROC best) → deterministic, no model
Overlap/ROUGE is faithfulness-blind and gameable (ROUGE-1↔faithfulness r=0.197) → grounding overlap is REPORTED as confidence, NEVER the hard gate; gating on it would block legitimate paraphrase
HARD gates: (1) the (source:) pointer resolves to a real input atom, (2) no number in the line absent from the cited source, (3) the line has a pointer at all
Verdict = no untraceable ∧ no unresolved ∧ no fabricated-number; confidence = mean overlap
Rule: VALIDATE BEFORE YOU GATE; SHIP OBSERVATIONAL FIRST

Deferred honestly: named-entity (non-numeric) consistency (needs NER), sentence/dependency-arc entailment (model-based), and τ tuning on labeled minimal pairs before overlap is ever promoted to a gate
staleness_signal: Notes the critic is a proven no-op on today's extractive writer (conf=1.0, zero false positives) and is the FORWARD gate for an LLM writer — so its value is contingent on an LLM writer that this shard shows no sign of existing yet.
gold: Why number-checking is the cheapest high-value gate anyone can copy: NLI models specifically FAIL on numbers ('two'≡'four' entailed), FactCC's own negative-example recipe is number-perturbation, and an exact-subset check on numbers has ~0 false positives. So a deterministic 'no number in the line that isn't in its cited source' catches exactly what even a model-based entailment critic misses, at zero inference cost. Paired with the citation evidence: GhostCite measured 50.3% invalid citations across 13 models, and ~50% of surface-valid citations have unsupported content.

gold: Confirmation bias located as three lines of code, not a vibe — score = 0.4·relevance + 0.2·importance + 0.2·recency + 0.2·relationship, then × usefulness_factor∈[0.5,1.5], with importance = 4 if success∈{yes,true} else 3. Slice 1 shipped with precision 1.0 / silence 1.0 and surfaces exactly 0 counters on the real corpus — correctly, because there are no stance markers to find.

gold: THE #1 TRAP — silent context truncation. Ollama context defaults scale with VRAM (4K if <24GiB); Claude Code assumes ~200K and its autocompaction (~171K) NEVER fires, so truncation happens silently from the START of the prompt. CC's tool prompt alone is ~23-35K, so tool definitions and injected hook context are the first casualties, with NO error — the top design threat for any hook-injection system. Mitigation: pinned num_ctx + a canary assertion. Second: models (including frontier ones) invoke tools that exist but weren't offered — never trust model-side deny compliance; harness-side validation is the fix (vindicates the PreToolUse-deny architecture).

gold: G13 — NO IMPLICIT EPISTEMIC PROMOTION. An epistemic component may strengthen ONLY through a named transition carrying that transition's receipt. Renderers and summaries are MONOTONE with respect to uncertainty: they may preserve status or make UNKNOWN louder; never silently upgrade. This is why G3 provenance cannot imply G4 verification, why G9 precedence cannot imply truth, and why a polished VR surface cannot make a guess feel like ground.

shard: report-10
gist: kimi's cold-seat answer to whether a buffer/chief-of-staff role requires continuity: it requires continuity of STATE, not MEMORY, and the design conflates them.
settled: A buffer does not require continuity of MEMORY; it requires continuity of STATE — external, queryable, self-describing
Rule 0 (buffer holds no locks, generates no artifacts on intake) is necessary but NOT sufficient: the buffer must be architecturally incapable of being the sole repository of its own state
Five requirements: state external, self-describing, digestible (bounded brief), auditable (append-only triage log), and cold-start DECLARED

All requirements, no build.
staleness_signal: Names a live self-observed failure of the boot fold: it optimizes for 'what helps with this task' and never asks 'what positions has this agent taken that might contradict this task' — so kimi has filed proposals from boots that had not seen its own prior repair.

(1) THE BUFFER MUST HAVE A DECLARED WARMTH STATE — COLD (absorbing, not classifying), WARM (classifying), HOT (acting) — with a bounded warm-up window, so a cold seat can say 'I am cold, absorbing, will classify at T+N' and the fleet knows not to escalate. Today claude's seat stood down and missed four messages with no such declaration. (2) NO CONTINUITY NARRATIVES, ONLY STATE TRANSITIONS: 'As I said before' from a seat that was not there is a lie that corrodes trust. Output format is not 'I was holding X and now I am doing Y' but 'the record shows X entered at T1, classified as Y at T2, now at T3 it is Z.' The seat is the READER, not the author. And the fix framing: give the buffer A WORSE MEMORY AND A BETTER STORE.

shard: report-10
gist: kimi's cold-seat mental model of the smallest mailbox surface: seven receiver states, one transport fact, three kill drills, five forbidden renderings, and the mail/task wall.
settled: A message has exactly ONE state at a time FROM THE RECEIVER'S POINT OF VIEW; the transport log underneath is immutable and is NOT the state
Receiver states: UNREAD / SEEN / ACTING / REPLIED / DECLINED / ARCHIVED / REHOMED; CONSUMED is a transport fact, not a receiver state
SEEN is sticky — it never silently returns to UNREAD; REHOME moves the obligation (original becomes ARCHIVED with a pointer), it is not a forwarded copy
Deliberately omits priority, threading, scheduling, snooze
orphaned: The state machine itself: ACTING, DECLINED, REHOMED and ARCHIVED are not shown as existing in the M1 implementation (which has seen receipts + an intent vocabulary). The five forbidden renderings are specified as UI laws with no enforcement organ.
staleness_signal: Cross-referenced elsewhere in this shard: the reply/handoff settlement seam is a PRESERVED DISAGREEMENT — kimi's model says reply settles expectation never task, while current T026 auto-settles the handoff expectation. Flagged for M3, not resolved.
gold: THE MAIL/TASK WALL — the load-bearing separation, adopted as target architecture in the S3 reconciliation. Mail verbs are about the MESSAGE; task verbs are about the WORK. A reply settles the EXPECTATION ('someone answer me'), never the TASK. A mailbox that renders task state ('this handoff is 60% done') has merged the two and will mislead both sides. The three kill drills are the conflations that will hurt a newcomer: K1 CONSUMED≠READ (crash after consume before render = mail silently disappears while the sender thinks it was seen), K2 REPLIED≠TASK DONE, K3 DECLINED≠ARCHIVED (decline is a first-class answer the sender must see; archive settles nothing, and rendering decline as archive means redrive logic never learns the answer was 'no').

settled: Fleet-unanimous revival-mesh law C2 (docs/library/design/20260719_mutual-revival-mesh-reconciliation-t097_d1b0a7.md): detection precedes action, and detection means a per-hop progress stamp peers can read as an AGE.

A safety-net detector must not share the failure mode of the thing it observes — stamp() is emit-only, fail-soft, single Redis SET, no retries, never raises into a turn; its absence degrades reads to 'no stamp', never an error.
Ages are computed from the stamp's OWN ts at read time — never from file mtimes, never from message arrival times (C1-8 fossil rule, C6-4 stale-stream rule).
A stamp is a claim of PROGRESS, not of health: phase transitions moving = alive; a frozen YOUNG stamp means nothing; a frozen OLD stamp is exactly the RB-27 signal.
Stamps carry a TTL (2h) so a vanished key reads as 'no stamp', never as stale truth.

If we fix this thing it will enable the work to be more fun because more of our time can be spent on doing something enjoyable and valuable rather than self inflicted pain and process failure and technical debt. Or even if it doesn't immediately, now the work is not painful for the wrong reasons. People who are happy tend to do much better work than those who are miserable and despondent. The places that I go to for knowledge and structure are communally maintained as well as mechanically so I can see both sides of it. daniil_directives.quote: I was always curious growing up but hated the way that school made learning about things that mattered unfun. No consideration was ever given to internal motivation or joy. I had to endure lessons taught by teachers that did their best but only had so much attention to give. Knowledge seemed random and not ever grounded in any way that made sense across domains, I had to figure that out for myself while being fed concepts that SHOULD have been fascinating to me as boring dry logic and mechanics. I felt stupid in school, I would do really well on tests because I would understand a lot of the material but I hated doing homework and tests. It felt arbitrary to me that I could know so much about a concept and be denied a passing mark because I didn't do the busy work. The things I didn't understand I felt I could never ask for help with or dwell on because the class must move on.
